Wirecat runs entirely on your device.

Data usage monitoring: app-by-app data usage is read from Android's built-in usage-access APIs and is never uploaded anywhere.

Tunnel and packet capture: when you turn on Tunnel or enable "Capture packets while monitoring," Wirecat creates a local VPN interface purely to see and, for Tunnel, block traffic on your own device - no traffic is ever routed through an external server, and packet contents themselves are not read or stored, only metadata such as protocol, size, timestamp, and which app it came from.

Storage: session history and packet logs are saved in a local database inside the app's private storage on your device. Nothing is synced or backed up to any server, and you can delete any or all of it at any time from the History screen.

Donations: the donate link opens an external page in your browser; Wirecat has no part in and does not see any information you provide there.

Outside of the donation link you choose to open, Wirecat makes no other network connections and does not collect, transmit, or sell your personal data.
